overview.overview:
Nebraska's 1st Congressional District, which casts one electoral vote, backed the Republican presidential nominee by about 15 points in 2020 and about 13 points in 2024. It has leaned well to the right of the nation as a whole in both elections.

The forecast expects a Republican win, with the likely range running from a Republican margin of about 18 points to a narrow Democratic lead of about 3 points. No district-level polls or recent headlines are available, so the outlook rests on past results and the national environment, which narrows the expected Republican margin relative to the district's baseline.
overview.watch: Shifts in the national political environment or the emergence of district-specific polling would be the most likely developments to change this outlook.
key_factors: The district voted Republican by roughly 13 to 15 points in the last two presidential elections.
It leans noticeably more Republican than the country overall.
The national environment adjustment narrows the expected Republican margin by about 5.5 points.
